documents.text: Instead, they saw it as a party working primarily for the benefit of others, especially African Americans, advocacy groups of the political left, and the very poor. In 1984, Reagan carried 49 states against former vice president and Minnesota senator Walter Mondale, a New Deal stalwart. [121] In response to these landslide defeats, the Democratic Leadership Council (DLC) was created in 1995. It worked to reposition the Democratic Party as a centrist force in American politics, appealing to moderate voters who had previously supported Republican candidates.
